content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

Selling music online is not just about the product; it's about having the right infrastructure to handle payments seamlessly. Many digital creators are left out of conventional payment systems due to geographical restrictions or high fees, such as Gumroad's 10% charge on sales. By utilizing a crypto payment processor like NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5%, you can keep more of your revenue. This matters because it allows creators to focus on their art while having complete control over their sales process.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The foundational architecture for selling music online includes several interconnected components. You'll utilize GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your store, which is free. The backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring smooth operation. For order storage, you can use Supabase or even Google Sheets, both of which are accessible without costs. Finally, integrating NOWPayments allows you to accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies for transactions, providing flexibility and immediate payment confirmation.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where mainstream payment platforms are either unavailable or impose high fees. Musicians, authors, and designers can directly reach their audience without intermediary restrictions. This model empowers creators to take ownership of their digital storefronts. By leveraging this architecture, you strengthen your business against external financial pressures and retain more of your revenue, ultimately allowing for greater creative freedom and growth.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, keeping more in your pocket.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component of this digital architecture plays a critical role in ensuring a seamless experience for both creators and buyers. Hosting on GitHub or Cloudflare keeps your costs down while providing a reliable platform. The backend logic from Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script enables automated processes, such as order confirmations and product deliveries. NOWPayments simplifies accepting cryptocurrency, ensuring low fees and immediate access to funds. Together, these components create an efficient and effective system for selling music online.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by selecting either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your hosting needs. Next, set up your backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage transactions and deliveries. Create an account with NOWPayments to integrate cryptocurrency payment processing. Finally, upload your music products, ensuring they are easily accessible for buyers. With these steps, you can quickly establish your online store and begin selling music without the constraints of traditional payment systems.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, utilize a sovereign digital commerce stack. By deploying a solution using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, along with NOWPayments, you can accept payments in cryptocurrencies directly. This approach eliminates reliance on traditional payment platforms and significantly reduces fees compared to options like Gumroad.
Deploy your store on GitHub Pages for free and retain full ownership.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

This post connects well with searches about selling ebooks without PayPal or Stripe. For comprehensive guidance on building your digital storefront, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). It provides all necessary blueprints and templates to establish your infrastructure. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions

You can set up your music store using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting. Use NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, which allows you to accept payments without relying on PayPal.
What are the costs associated with selling music online?

With NOWPayments, you pay only a 0.5% fee per transaction, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. This cost-effective solution allows you to retain more revenue from your sales.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad?
Yes, by deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can sell templates and fonts directly from your own store. You’ll have full control over sales and payment processing.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my music sales?
Using NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies for your music sales. This flexibility allows you to cater to a broader range of customers who prefer to pay with crypto.
Is there ongoing support after setting up my store?
When you deploy your digital commerce infrastructure, you receive 30-day support to help you through any initial challenges. After that, you own everything without ongoing fees.
